note: RV park behind the lodge of a Lake Taneycomo cabin resort east of Branson, with a pool and a fishing dock on the lake; the RV rows sit behind the resort buildings rather than on the shore. Also sells monthly sites. --Claude
summary: Operator page + Firefly read: 30A pull-through $49.95, 50A $54.95 (Nov and Jun), monthly $750; full hookups 30/50A, showers, laundry, Wi-Fi. Nightly units: 8 of 9 open 2026-11-17, 9 of 9 on 2027-06-08. Imagery: RV block ~75 m from the lake behind the lodge buildings - not waterfront stands.
flags: Waterfront: stored 'not waterfront' CONFIRMED. Imagery: the RV block (gravel rows of pads) sits behind the lodge and office buildings, its nearest pads ~75 m from Lake Taneycomo with the buildings and parking between, so no sightline from the pads. A few rigs parked on a lane NE of the lodge, ~30-40 m from the shore, could not be matched to Firefly site numbers - unconfirmed, so not counted. The name and the fishing dock are not evidence.

Price gate: $49.95 pre-tax (30A pull-through) on Firefly; Branson gateway 3 km in any case. Presence: operator site with phone (417) 334-7375 + Firefly booking; Google 4.5 over 212 reviews; RV Life 4* over 12.

LONG-STAY (passes): the RV page leads with '$750.00 MONTHLY'. Firefly offers Nightly and 'ONGOING Pay monthly' types; the nightly search lists 9 RV units (sites 26, 27, 29, 31-34, 39, 40), 8 bookable on 2026-11-17 (Tue) and all 9 on 2027-06-08 (Tue). RV Life lists ~26 sites, so about 1 in 3 is sold nightly. Five tests: (1) $49.95 pass; (2) nightly online booking, no approval - pass; (3) 1-night stays sell - pass; (4) ~9 of ~26 - pass; (5) RV park at a cabin resort - pass. Watch item: an RV Life reviewer (4/2025) wrote of the new owners 'The RV park will become a permanent RV location but until then...' - it still sells nightly today.
